method: Separate stdlib receipt reader; exact literals typed independently; hashes recomputed from bytes. Neither producer nor auditor imported. SQLite databases were never opened and no process/suite was launched.
core_outcome: One deterministic suite: both main-file-only-copy readers report structural integrity ok but stale generation0. Both source and SQLite-backup readers report exact committed generation1, excluding staged uncommitted generation2.
physical_read_observation: Read-only WAL opens in this writable directory created empty WAL and 32768-byte SHM sidecars for copied/backup DBs. Source SHM hash changed on first read; original source main/WAL bytes remained as captured. Logical read-only does not establish zero physical file changes.
limits: Known SQLite behavior; no novelty claim.
One suite and six reopenings are not scientific independent replications. Check cardinality is evidence bookkeeping.
Fresh reader processes are not Gateway/service restarts.
No external provider effect, sustained concurrent workload, throughput/cost measurement or liveness proof.
Process os._exit is not power loss, corruption, torn-write durability certification or production reliability.
No evidence uncommitted generation2 pages reached disk; the test establishes their absence from committed reader snapshots.
